document.abstract: The basic requirements which govern the success of black-light installations in the motion picture theater have been accurately determined. The demonstrated difficulty of satisfying those requirements indicates the need of a new technique.- A prefabricated and ready-packaged mural and black-light combination is suggested as the answer to the problem.
